facts.fact: Hiiraan Online reports Somalia's Upper House approved the National Payment System Bill, drafted by the Ministry of Finance, by 28 votes to none after the House of the People passed it with 154 votes in November 2025; it awaits the president's signature.

facts.fact: Hiiraan Online says mobile money plays a central role in daily economic life in Somalia and the payments sector is rapidly expanding.
